<TITLE>EX-3.2</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>EXHIBIT 3.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SLR SECURED SPECIALTY LENDING FUND </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DECLARATION OF TRUST </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This <B>DECLARATION OF TRUST</B>, dated as of May&nbsp;7, 2026, is made by the individual trustee identified on the signature page hereto (the
&#8220;<B><U>Trustee</U></B>&#8221;). The Trustee hereby agrees as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;1. The trust formed hereby (the
&#8220;<B><U>Trust</U></B>&#8221;) shall be known as &#8220;SLR Secured Specialty Lending Fund&#8221; in which name the Trustee may conduct the business of the Trust, make and execute contracts, and sue and be sued. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;2. It is the intention of the parties hereto that the Trust created hereby constitute a statutory trust under Chapter 38 of Title
12 of the Delaware Code, 12 Del. Code &#167;&nbsp;3801 <U>et</U> <U>seq</U>. (the &#8220;<B><U>Statutory Trust Act</U></B>&#8221;), and that this document constitutes the governing instrument of the Trust. The Trustee is hereby authorized and
directed to execute and file a certificate of trust in the office of the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware in the form attached hereto. The Trust is hereby established by the Trustee for the purpose of becoming a <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">closed-end</FONT> management investment company that intends to elect to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;<B><U>1940 Act</U></B>&#8221;), and
engaging in such other activities as are necessary, convenient or incidental thereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;3. The Trustee intends to enter into
an amended and restated Declaration of Trust, satisfactory to each party thereto, to provide for the contemplated operation of the Trust formed hereby. Prior to the execution and delivery of such amended and restated Declaration of Trust, the
Trustee shall not have any duty or obligation hereunder or with respect to the trust estate, except as required by law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;4.
The Trustee may appoint and replace officers of the Trust to serve (a)&nbsp;until his successor shall have been elected and shall have qualified, (b)&nbsp;until his death or (c)&nbsp;until he shall have resigned or have been removed by the Trustee.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;5. The Trustee and the officer(s) of the Trust are hereby authorized: (i)&nbsp;to prepare and file with the Securities and
Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<B><U>Commission</U></B>&#8221;) and execute, in each case on behalf of the Trust, (a)&nbsp;a Registration Statement on Form 10, including any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-effective</FONT> or post-effective
amendments to such Registration Statement, relating to the registration of the Trust under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;<B><U>Exchange Act</U></B>&#8221;), and a Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">N-54A</FONT>
relating to the election of the Trust to be subject to Sections 55 through 65 of the 1940 Act and (b)&nbsp;any additional filing request, report or application or amendment thereto with the Commission that may be required from time to time under the
1940 Act, the Exchange Act or the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and the respective rules and regulations promulgated thereunder; (ii)&nbsp;to cause the Trust to elect to be treated as a regulated investment company under Subchapter M of the
Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, as may be set forth in a Registration Statement referenced herein; (iii)&nbsp;to prepare, execute and file, in each case on behalf of the Trust, such applications, reports, surety bonds, irrevocable
consents, appointments of attorney for service of process and other papers and documents as shall be necessary or desirable to register the securities of the Trust under the securities or &#8220;blue sky&#8221; laws of such jurisdictions as the
Trustee and officers may deem necessary or desirable; (iv)&nbsp;to negotiate the terms of, and execute on behalf of the Trust, such investment advisory agreements and other contracts among the Trust and any other persons relating to the issuance of
the securities of the Trust, satisfactory to each such party; and (v)&nbsp;to make any and all necessary filings and to take any and all actions, including, without limitation, the execution and delivery of any and all documents, amendments,
certificates or other instruments, including with respect to any exemptive relief sought by the Trust from the Commission, that they, together with and upon the advice of counsel, shall deem necessary or advisable to conduct the business of the
Trust, such determination to be conclusively evidenced by the taking of such actions and steps and the execution and delivery of such documents, amendments, certificates or other instruments. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;6. The number of Trustees initially shall be one (1)&nbsp;and thereafter the number of Trustees shall be such number as shall be
fixed from time to time by a written instrument signed by a majority of the Trustees, which may increase or decrease the number of Trustees; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that the number of Trustees shall in no event be less than one (1). Subject
to the foregoing, the Trustees, acting by majority vote, are entitled to appoint or remove without cause any Trustee at any time. Any Trustee may resign upon 30 days prior notice to the other Trustees. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;7. (a) The Trustee and the officers of the Trust (the &#8220;<B><U>Fiduciary
Indemnified Persons</U></B>&#8221;) shall not be liable, responsible or accountable in damages or otherwise to the Trust, the Trustee or any holder of the Trust&#8217;s securities for any loss, damage or claim incurred by reason of any act or
omission performed or omitted by the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons in good faith on behalf of the Trust and in a manner the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons reasonably believed to be within the scope of authority conferred on the Fiduciary Indemnified
Persons by this Declaration of Trust or by law, except that the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons shall be liable for any such loss, damage or claim incurred by reason of the Fiduciary Indemnified Person&#8217;s gross negligence, bad faith or willful
misfeasance with respect to such acts or omissions, or by reason of reckless disregard on the part of a Fiduciary Indemnified Person of the duties involved in the conduct of such Fiduciary Indemnified Person&#8217;s office. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Fiduciary Indemnified Persons shall be fully protected in relying in good faith upon the records of the Trust and upon such
information, opinions, reports or statements presented to the Trust by any person as to matters the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons reasonably believes are within such other person&#8217;s professional or expert competence and who has been selected
with reasonable care by or on behalf of the Trust, including information, opinions, reports or statements as to the value and amount of the assets, liabilities, profits, losses, or any other facts pertinent to the trust estate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;8. The Trust shall, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) indemnify and hold harmless each Fiduciary Indemnified Person from and against any loss, damage, liability, claim, action, suit, tax,
penalty, expense or claim of any kind or nature whatsoever incurred by the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons by reason of the creation, operation or termination of the Trust, except that no Fiduciary Indemnified Persons shall be entitled to be
indemnified in respect of any loss, damage, liability, action, suit or claim incurred by the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons by reason of gross negligence, bad faith or willful misfeasance with respect to such acts or omissions, nor by reason of
reckless disregard on the part of a Fiduciary Indemnified Person of the duties involved in the conduct of such Fiduciary Indemnified Person&#8217;s office; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) advance expenses (including legal fees) incurred by a Fiduciary Indemnified Person in defending any claim, demand, action, suit or
proceeding shall, from time to time, prior to the final disposition of such claim, demand, action, suit or proceeding, upon receipt by the Trust of an undertaking by or on behalf of such Fiduciary Indemnified Persons to repay such amount if it shall
be determined that such Fiduciary Indemnified Person is not entitled to be indemnified as authorized in the preceding subsection. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;9. The provisions of Section&nbsp;8 shall survive the resignation or removal of the Fiduciary Indemnified Persons. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;10. This Declaration of Trust and certificate of trust of the Trust, and any provisions contained therein, may be amended,
altered, changed or repeated by the Trustee without any requirement for the consent or approval of any other person or entity. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;11. The Trust may dissolve, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">wind-up</FONT> and terminate without issuing any securities at the
election of the Trustee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;12. This Declaration of Trust and the rights of the parties hereunder shall be governed by and
interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware applicable to contracts formed and to be performed entirely within the State of Delaware, and all rights and remedies shall be governed by such laws, in each case without regard to the
principles of conflict of laws thereof, to the extent such principles would require or permit the application of the laws of another jurisdiction. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>[REMAINDER OF PAGE INTENTIONALLY BLANK] </B></P>
</DIV></Center>

executed as of the day and year first above written. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">
